noticias.titulo: Tesla-SpaceX Merger Is Elon Musk’s Biggest AI Bet Yet - Bloomberg
noticias.resumo: After months of rumors, Elon Musk confirmed that Tesla and SpaceX are working towards a merger, and AI — which was not the business of either company — is the big reason driving the combination.  SpaceX just showed that AI revenue is already surpassing that of the firm’s prior primary driver: connectivity.  There’s fresh evidence, in other words, that AI can generate billions for SpaceX.
